The '''Shark underwater fighter''' was an underwater vehicle employed by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] for battle during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="SWL32" />

==Characteristics==
The vessel was a one-man fighter for use in underwater environments. It had a design similar to the ancient [[Sith fighter|Sith interceptor]], with an additional tailfin, while the pilot's cockpit was similar to that of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] fighters. The craft was armed with two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and had four thrusters, one primary located in the center of the rear fuselage.<ref name="SWL32" />

==History==
These vessels were employed by the Imperial Army's [[Shark Squadron]] to hunt down [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees following [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s order to [[Genocide on Dac|exterminate]] all Mon Calamari.<ref name="SWL32" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shark underwater fighters first appeared in [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']], a [[2009]] story arc in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]]. It was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Omar Francia]].
